metric_definition.agreement: absolute difference between main and auxiliary one-step speed predictions
metric_definition.parameter_mismatch: EWMA(alpha=0.05) of absolute measured-minus-auxiliary residual while the physical sensor is trusted

calibration_population: clean validation trajectories only; no closed-loop holdout scenarios

threshold_derivation.param_mismatch_recovery_threshold: p95 of clean-validation EWMA (lower hysteresis threshold)
threshold_derivation.aux_recovery_gate: p99.9 of clean-validation auxiliary residual; independently reproduces V2 gate
threshold_derivation.aux_speed_bounds: fixed application/simulation operating envelope in rad/s, not a fitted percentile
threshold_derivation.param_mismatch_recovery_count: 50 samples = 0.5 s at the fixed 0.01 s simulation step
